id: title:jabahamondes:convert conversion goal revenue to the team base currency

review.posthog_relevance: Adds currency conversion support to HogQL conversion goal processing, allowing goals to specify a revenue currency and convert it to the team's base currency.
review.reason: The chunk explicitly implements currency retrieval and conditional currency handling within HogQL conversion goal processing. P1.F1.H3 retrieves the revenue currency property, while P1.F1.H2 contains the conditional check and return statement. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement: the ability to retrieve and use currency metadata for conversion goals. The
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the actual conversion implementation or database migration, so the tier is assigned based on the observable HogQL query changes rather than the complete end-to-end feature. The benefit relies on unverified downstream implementation and database compatibility.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the currency conversion function or the database migration, only the HogQL query processor and its tests. The score cannot be assigned without seeing the actual conversion implementation and its validation.

observations.behavior: Adds currency conversion support to conversion goal processing.
